The first errata word "addicta" is uncertain: the letter after "addi" is hard to read, so it is written as addicta without a [?]; check it. "Adulteros" and "adulteris" are read with some doubt in the first letter of the second word. The errata are printed as run-in lines, not a table, so each printed line is one line here. Last line ends with a printed hyphen at the page foot, kept as printed.
